title: Validate-and-Retry Tool Calls
learning_objectives: Validate structured output against a schema (types, required fields, enums, ranges)
Feed precise errors back to the model and retry
Bound retries and report every attempt
entry_point: validate(obj, schema); call_with_retries(model, prompt, schema, max_attempts=3)
hints: Loop `for f in sorted(schema)`; use `continue` after the first error for a field.
Type check: reject bools when the type is int/float; accept ints for float.
Retry loop: on failure append the raw text and the feedback string to messages.

failure_feedback.advice: Check fields in sorted order; report only the first failing check per field; unexpected fields last.
Append the model's text and 'Your output was invalid: ' + '; '.join(errors).
Stop at the first valid attempt and report attempts used.
Give up after max_attempts and return all error lists.
